description:
The proposed works involve the construction of a single storey modular building extension to provide a teaching space to be used for primary school children when undertaking outdoor subjects. The proposed extension is being funded and has been approved by London Borough of Sutton Council SEND Educational Team.

The school is a base for special educational needs children with Autistic Spectrum Disorder. The proposed modular building extension will be used to provide additional multi-use teaching spaces for their children with special educational needs. The facility will be used for groups of 6 - 12 children in number, depending on the activity. The proposal will comply with Building Bulletin 102 Designing for disabled children and children with special educational needs Guidance for mainstream and special schools.
subdivision_of_building: Existing single storey modular located to the rear of the school site

decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be similar to those of the original building and maintained and retained thereafter. This applies unless differences are shown on the drawings we have approved. Reason: To ensure that the extension harmonises with the existing building and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Risk Assessment Report unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
